newsitem.title: UK: British insurance firm launches virgin birth cover.
newsitem.headline: British insurance firm launches virgin birth cover.

text.p: A British insurance firm on Sunday offered "Virgin Birth By Act Of God" insurance.
Following the successful launch of its alien impregnation insurance policy to 300 women in just one week, city insurance broker Goodfellow Rebecca Ingrams Pearson (GRIP) offered the new policy.
Virgins pay two pounds ($3.15) a week and will be offered one million pounds if impregnated by "Act of God", it said.

"Virgins are genuinely concerned with the approach of the second millenium. Accordingly, we consider it to be our duty to provide coverage to help allay these concerns," said GRIP spokesman Simon Burgess in a statement.
"All claims will be assessed by a panel of independent experts who do not include members of the church from whom we have received a frosty response," he added.
